title: Dependency Reasoning for Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.14873v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Aspect Sentiment Quadruple Prediction (ASQP) is fundamentally a relational reasoning problem: identifying aspect-opinion-category-sentiment quadruples requires modeling structured dependencies, not merely sequential co-occurrence. Existing LLM-based approaches incorporate syntactic information indirectly, via retrieval-based demonstration selection or multi-stage training, rather than as unified, single-pass generation-time context. We present DRIFT, which linearizes dependency parse trees and injects them directly into LLM prompts as explicit relational context, enabling the model to reason over aspect-opinion dependencies rather than infer them from token proximity alone. DRIFT further integrates retrieval-augmented in-context learning and a syntax-aware LLM-based adjudication mechanism that complements exact-match evaluation under span-boundary variation. translated_title: 面向方面情感四元组预测的依存关系推理
translated_abstract: 方面情感四元组预测（ASQP）本质上是一个关系推理问题：识别“方面-观点-类别-情感”四元组需要对结构化依赖关系进行建模，而不仅仅是顺序上的共现。现有的基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法通过基于检索的示例选择或多阶段训练等方式间接引入句法信息，而非将其作为统一的、单次生成时的显式上下文。我们提出了DRIFT，该方法将依存句法分析树线性化，并作为显式的关系上下文直接注入LLM提示中，使模型能够对方面与观点之间的依赖关系进行推理，而不是仅凭词元邻近性来推断。DRIFT还进一步集成了检索增强的上下文学习以及一种语法感知的、基于LLM的裁决机制，该机制在跨度边界变化的情况下对精确匹配评估形成补充。在SemEval Rest15、Rest16和ACOS数据集上，DRIFT取得了最强的性能。
tldr: 该论文提出DRIFT方法，将依存句法树线性化后作为显式关系上下文直接注入LLM提示中，并结合检索增强的上下文学习与语法感知裁决机制，在方面情感四元组预测任务上取得了最优性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DRIFT, which linearizes dependency parse trees and injects them directly into LLM prompts as explicit relational context, combined with retrieval-augmented in-context learning and a syntax-aware LLM adjudication mechanism, achieving state-of-the-art performance on aspect sentiment quadruple prediction.
